lifecycle.creation_reason: Three distinct consequences of the MT-109 authorization hardening that MT-111 correctly identified but could not close within its allowed_paths or without unverifiable edits across seven other MTs proofs. Captured so none is lost, per the Operator standing deferral rule.

scope.summary: Close the remaining MT-109 authorization fallout: the Palmistry forwarder design question, the seven test harnesses that still read the recorder without a credential, and document_saved actor attribution.

part_1_palmistry.problem: src/frontend/palmistry/fr_forward.rs:52 FR_ROUTE_PATH still names the REMOVED unscoped /api/flight_recorder/runtime_chat_event. The constant is now dead.
part_1_palmistry.why_not_a_rename: Palmistry is an OUT-OF-PROCESS watcher whose entire purpose is surviving Handshake freezes and crashes. It has NO workspace id and NO native-MCP binding, so it can satisfy NEITHER half of the new contract (workspace-scoped path + session token). This is a genuine design question, not a mechanical fix.
part_1_palmistry.options_for_the_authority_owner: Either (a) give Palmistry a distinct capability and an out-of-process credential path appropriate to a watcher that must work when the app is dead, or (b) route Palmistry forwarding through a different ingestion boundary entirely, or (c) formally confirm the existing typed SchemaIncompatible deferral to WP-KERNEL-016 and REMOVE the dead constant so no future reader believes the route still exists.
part_1_palmistry.current_safety: It already returns a typed SchemaIncompatible blocker, so nothing regressed into silence.

part_2_test_harness_credentials.problem: Seven suites still read the Flight Recorder with NO credential and will 401 under the MT-109 gate: test_calendar_interop (4 sites), test_ckc_embed (1), test_e7_swarm_edit_proof (1), test_fems_interop_proofs (5 of 7), test_locus_interop (1), test_other_pillar_interop_proofs (6), test_code_note_cross_ref (2, stub server).
part_2_test_harness_credentials.mechanism_already_exists: MT-111 added the canonical shared helper: RealNativeMcpBinding plus live_flight_recorder_session_token() in tests/pg_proof_support/mod.rs, already applied successfully in test_flight_recorder_authz and test_event_emitter. MT-027 and MT-066 independently proved the same publish-a-real-binding pattern.
part_2_test_harness_credentials.requirement: Each suite needs RealNativeMcpBinding::publish() BEFORE its backend selection; the ordering is suite-specific. Under NO circumstances weaken, stub, feature-gate or bypass the authorization to make a suite green - present a genuine binding or report a blocking gap.

part_3_document_saved_attribution.problem: validate_document_save_receipt (flight_recorder.rs:897) now requires the save receipt ledger actor_id to equal the server-derived handshake-native:{pid}:{fingerprint}, but the frontend save path sends its own x-hsk-actor-id, so document_saved native-editor events will likely 400 HSK-400-INVALID-EVENT.
part_3_document_saved_attribution.note: Predicted from source by the MT-111 agent and NOT yet reproduced at runtime. Reproduce it first; if it does not reproduce, record that plainly and close this part.

acceptance_criteria: AC-115-1: the Palmistry question is RESOLVED by an explicit decision (credentialed watcher path, alternative ingestion boundary, or confirmed deferral with the dead constant removed) - not left as a dangling constant.

AC-115-2: all seven listed suites present a GENUINE binding and their recorder reads succeed, with zero weakening/stubbing/feature-gating of the MT-109 authorization. Any suite that cannot is reported as a typed blocking gap.
AC-115-3: document_saved attribution is either reproduced-and-fixed so a real frontend save lands a durable FR row, or proven not to reproduce, with runtime evidence either way.
AC-115-4: no MT-109 negative regresses - the 401/403 suite from test_flight_recorder_authz still passes unchanged.
proof_targets: PT-115-1: each of the seven suites executed live against real PostgreSQL with a real binding, exit 0.
PT-115-3: a real frontend document save proven to land (or proven to fail with a named typed error) at runtime.

hbr_obligations.PRIV: REQUIRED - this is authorization and attribution work; negative proof is mandatory.
hbr_obligations.INT: REQUIRED - the events must reach the real EventLedger/Flight Recorder authority path.
